newsitem.title: USA: US Gulf crude output off 600,000 bbls due to storm.
newsitem.headline: US Gulf crude output off 600,000 bbls due to storm.

text.p: U.S. crude oil producers lost an estimated 600,000 barrels due to Josephine, the tropical storm that moved through the Gulf of Mexico and began reducing output in some fields over the weekend, traders said Tuesday.
"Buyers are still out in the market making up for lost feed. A chunk of supply was lost," a Texas trader said, noting total lost volume on Monday was around 300,000 barrels.

Traders said the volume spread over a few days was having a bullish impact on domestic grades, given the limited amount of imports recently, as well as disruption to shipping at the U.S. deepwater Louisiana Offshore Oil Port (LOOP).
